parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description: Specifies whether to sort results in ascending order. This feature is disabled by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: The list of query filter conditions.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter parameter.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

- For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and PolarDB for MySQL, this parameter is applicable only to cluster instances. If you do not specify this parameter, the log details of the primary node are queried by default.
- For PolarDB-X 2.0, set this parameter to **polarx_cn** (compute node) or **polarx_dn** (data node).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The task type.

SQL engine-specific:

**SlowLogRequestOrigin**: aggregates logs by source IP address.

**SlowLogRequestUser**: aggregates logs by source user.

**SQL**: aggregates logs by SQL ID.


MongoDB engine-specific:

**SlowLogRequestOrigin**: aggregates logs by source IP address.

**SlowLogRequestUser**: aggregates logs by source user.

**SQL**: aggregates logs by Query ID.

**SlowLogRequestOpType**: aggregates logs by operation type.

**SlowLogRequestNamespace**: aggregates logs by namespace.

Redis engine-specific:

**SlowLogRequestNodeId**: aggregates logs by node ID.

**SlowLogRequestHostInsId**: aggregates logs by HostInsId.
